notes.title: Devlog #5 - We are changing the genre from casual puzzle to horror thriller!
notes.content:
🎮 Genre Update: Casual Adventure to Horrifying Thrills! 🎮

Prepare to delve into the depths of darkness as we unleash the horror upon Conundrum Catacombs. Our team has been working tirelessly to bring you an entirely new and bone-chilling gaming experience. Get ready to face your worst nightmares and embark on a journey that will keep you on the edge of your seat!

🎥 Watch the Teaser Trailer on YouTube! 🎥

To give you a glimpse of the spine-tingling horrors that await, we have released an exclusive teaser trailer on YouTube. Brace yourself and click on the link below to witness the nightmarish transformation of Conundrum Catacombs:

[previewyoutube=gJg9G6eIOMY;full][/previewyoutube]

🌑 Uncover New Terrifying Gameplay Features 🌑

With this genre update, we've introduced a plethora of hair-raising gameplay elements that will test your bravery and survival instincts. Encounter haunting environments, spine-chilling creatures, and heart-pounding moments that will make you question every step you take. Be prepared to face your deepest fears head-on!

🗓️ Release Date and Sinister Surprises 🗓️

Mark your calendars for the spine-chilling release date of our horror-themed update! Get ready to immerse yourself in the darkness on the 6th of December, 2023. But beware, there might be additional sinister surprises lurking in the shadows, waiting to be revealed!

🕛 Stay Tuned for More Updates! 🕛

Follow us on Steam and keep an eye on our community page for more bone-chilling updates, behind-the-scenes sneak peeks, and developer insights. We can't wait to see you trembling in terror as you dive into the abyss of horror in Conundrum Catacombs!

Are you ready to embrace the horror? Prepare yourself for the nightmare that awaits!

Stay clear of the darkness,
DeathGho

notes.title: Update 7/13/2023 - Conundrum Catacombs Version Production 0.1.3
notes.content:
Added the following:

Monster which chases the player and has a patrol path

Notes that are interactive and can be activated to provide story information

Decorations in the form of skeletons, some bloody some not, to add to the immersion

Heartbeat sounds when the player has a lower torch level

Sounds for the monster

Ambiance audio loop

Changed the following:

The turkey leg is no longer a pick up and now is an item which can be picked up and used whenever you need a speed boost

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Adding SFX to the Demo for Itch.io!
notes.content:
"I am thrilled to announce the release of the demo for my latest game on itch.io! As a small indie developer, I have poured my heart and soul into creating this game, and I am excited to share it with you all.

The demo will give you a taste of what's to come in the full game and allow you to experience the unique gameplay mechanics and immersive world that I have created. I am confident that you will love it and can't wait to hear your feedback.

To access the demo, simply head over to itch.io and search for my game. From there, you can download the demo and start playing right away.

Thank you all for your continued support and enthusiasm for my work. I hope you enjoy the demo and stay tuned for more updates and announcements regarding the full game's release."
[previewyoutube=IgkzG-JABIQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
